concept: 空一拍 / A Beat of Room
core_sentence: Two people who reserve the same moving vacancy for their separate destinations must surrender both reservations to occupy a place together.

nearest_works.title: Playtime
nearest_works.difference: Architectural malfunction produces social pleasure there; here correctly working infrastructure exposes two competing invitations.

nearest_works.title: Neighbours
nearest_works.difference: Shared territory causes violent possession there; here relinquishing a claim enables courtship.

nearest_works.title: Virtual Insanity
nearest_works.difference: An important missed predecessor: moving-room choreography is established. The proposed vacancy exchange and mutual surrender provide the distinct story, not the moving buildings alone.

formal_invention: Call-and-response editing passes an empty architectural bay between the leads; repeated footwork changes from claiming to releasing to moving without controlling anything.

banned_touched.note: Cyberpunk engineering is transformed into a bright coastal city with Chinese protagonists exercising agency.
The spectacle montage is subordinated to one recurrent spatial exchange; it remains an execution risk.

median_touched.note: The date depends on an exchange rule, not scenic changes.

core_sentence: Two people carried past each other on separate moving floors can meet only when one stops matching the other's movements and waits for an answer.

nearest_works.title: Pas de deux
nearest_works.difference: McLaren multiplies dancers through optical printing. Here edits initially construct a shared duet from separated bodies, then the ending withdraws the edit and proves their physical meeting.

nearest_works.title: Virtual Insanity
nearest_works.difference: Moving architecture already has a major music-video precedent. Here separate arrival times generate a waiting decision between two people rather than a solo spatial illusion.

nearest_works.title: Your Name
nearest_works.difference: The familiar scaffold is lovers missing each other; our distance is visible, present-tense machinery with no lost memories, concealed time gap or disaster reversal.

formal_invention: An apparent duet is assembled by completing one person's gesture in the other's shot; the final partnership is made real by retaining both bodies through the moments where earlier sections cut away.

banned_touched.note: Fast dance cutting carries a repeated relational pattern; ordinary scenes, docking decisions and persistent geography prevent it becoming the core.
Futuristic coastal engineering belongs to Chinese people with agency, under clear daylight rather than borrowed neon-noir scenery.

median_touched.note: The repeated missed arrival and voluntary wait supply consequences beyond attractive surfaces.

material.qualification: Verified primary educational apparatus description. These details can appear in the miniature copy, but this is a well-circulated demonstration, not obscure practitioner testimony. Do not award Material 5 or treat metre-scale mechanics as validated at city scale.

complaint: The decisive passage of a buoyant dance film is a person waiting, and the ending declines a kiss.
notes: Selected for the strongest relationship between the medium, the song's repeated choruses and the characters' change. Spectacle creates distance; the held two-shot resolves it.
The brief limits production to two travelling galleries and one fixed transfer island. Fifteen full-size galleries, additional projection systems and an outward-voyage subplot are unnecessary.

Clarify the repeated error as staying aboard when the other gallery passes, not a puzzle about mathematically incorrect dance steps. Lin waits ashore; Yu sees her and joins through a stationary docking connection.
Show the island early. Preserve eyelines and landmarks. Verify the decisive crossing and real shared-floor dance in the actual selected footage.
Retain the entire 253.96-second supplied recording. The hard stop is visual only. No narration, extra exposition, inserted audio silence or reordered song sections.
selection_type: Single-concept selection with production clarifications; no borrowed mechanism from space or ritual

production_rescore.reason: Rechecked the clarified version from scratch; simpler geography improves execution confidence without earning an unsupported novelty or material increase.

core_sentence: When a community trades floating for standing, its finest airborne performer must choose between finishing a perfect solo and beginning an awkward grounded dance with a partner.

nearest_works.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
nearest_works.difference: Rotation establishes a technological world there; here changing weight would transform an intimate ritual.

nearest_works.title: WALL·E
nearest_works.difference: Romantic flight is a reward there; here romance culminates in accepting shared weight.

nearest_works.title: Upside Down & Inside Out
nearest_works.difference: The judge adds a direct music-video precedent for choreography under changing gravity. The mutual cleat-release ritual, rather than weightlessness itself, is this concept's distinct core.

formal_invention: Repeated choreography and diminishing camera rolls change airborne virtuosity into the effort of standing together; the opening ankle assistance is reversed in the final voluntary release.

banned_touched.note: Bright, practical habitat hardware replaces the passive neon megacity.
Ceremonial spectacle is tethered to one partner exchange rather than a changing list of beautiful locations.

median_touched.note: The gravity-romance association is inverted: the couple accepts weight and ends walking.

material.qualification: Independently verified in the primary technical report. Folding the rail, mutual ceremonial release and rapid social adaptation to spin gravity are fictional transformations.

material.qualification: Supports an area of exploratory engineering work, not a forecast that this society or its spin-up ceremony will exist.

tempo.clock: Shortening airborne travel and a settling calibration braid

complaint: Standing badly becomes more valuable than finishing the beautiful aerial performance.
notes: Best concrete source material and a memorable reciprocal object gesture. A strong separate film.
Not selected because a short joyful music film would need viewers to learn the gravity transition, former restraint use, social rite and performer's decision simultaneously.
The central change depends heavily on convincing continuous weight, contact and three-dimensional aerial performance; a still reel can illustrate it but cannot prove it.
Do not mix its cleat ceremony or orbital setting into Borrow a Step: either would create an additional explanation system.
